title: Related Questions
question: Related Questions Q. I am from India & presently working in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. I follow the Hanafi maslak. Sometimes due to work related travel I mis the jamat of Zohar salah. But I try to reach the masjid at the earliest to perform my Zohar salah. But sometime it happens that when I reach the masjid I find that Asar Jamat (as per Hambali timing) has started. But as per Hanafi salah timetable I still have time for our Zohar salah, as Asar time has not started as per Hanafi timetable. Now my question is what should I do? Do i read the Zohar salah first & then try to join the jamat of Asar which has already started may be the jamat may be over before I complete my Zohar salah. or I directly join the jamat for Asar salah & read my Zohar after that? I am very confused. But this happens only sometimes may be once in 3-4 months. 3562 views Q. answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 959 Country: United Kingdom Title: In the UK in our Masjid we currently follow Mushada time table for Subha Sadiq which has been proven to be wrong by Mufti Taqi Saab as Mushada in Uk is not possible. Could you give a fatwa regarding this so that our Rozas are accepted? Question: In the UK in our Masjid we currently follow Mushada time table for Subha Sadiq which has been proven to be wrong by Mufti Taqi Saab as Mushada in Uk is not possible. Could you give a fatwa regarding this so that our Rozas are accepted? Answer ID: 959 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 485=473/N) In this regard, the timetable of Hazrat Mufti Taqi Usmani should be followed which he has laid down for times of Salah and Sawm . Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
